message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport (IATA) | City / State | Notable Features |
|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta, GA | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | Key gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and United. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago, IL | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United and American. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver, CO | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York City, NY | Primary hub for United and American; major gateway to Europe and the Caribbean. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco, CA | Hub for United and a major gateway to Asia. |
| **Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for United. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami, FL | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando, FL | Major hub for Southwest; one of the busiest airports for leisure travel. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix, AZ | Hub for American Airlines; major gateway to the Southwest and Mexico. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston, TX | Major hub for United; significant cargo operations. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte, NC | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| **McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas, NV | Major hub for Southwest; key gateway to the entertainment capital. |

These airports serve as major hubs for domestic and international flights, handling millions of passengers each year and connecting the U.S. to the rest of the world.
